submittedPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent 128x128 RPG inventory material icon, runtime displayed at 32x32.
Primary request: depict one muted fragment from a cracked ancient copper bell.
Subject: a single curved shard broken from a small heavy bell, with a clearly jagged chipped rim, weathered bronze-copper surface, and one tiny dark clapper nub still attached. It should read as a bell fragment, not a whole bell.
Style/medium: crisp polished 2D pixel-art RPG item icon, chunky coherent pixel clusters, limited palette, strong outline, sharp edges, high contrast at small size; match high-quality 16-bit inventory art, no 3D, no painterly blur.
Composition/framing: one compact centered fragment only, large enough to read at 32x32, on a square transparent canvas with comfortable clear margins.
Lighting/mood: muted warm copper highlight and cool shadow; old, silent, and sturdy.
Color palette: oxidized copper, dark bronze, restrained sea-glass teal patina and charcoal outline.
Constraints: request genuine transparent alpha. No background, checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, text, label, symbol, watermark, UI, whole intact bell, extra shards, people, monsters, glow, blur, gradient, detached particles or cropped edges.
acceptance: Accepted: one centered, readable transparent material icon with a clean silhouette and enough margin for 32x32 runtime display.

normalization.method: Crop alpha>8 subject bounds with 4.5% margin; Lanczos fit within 104x104 and center on a transparent 128x128 canvas.

visualReviewNote: One chipped curved bell shard with the clapper nub still attached remains legible at 32x32 display size.
